summary.text: Patt Maney represents District 4 in the Florida House of Representatives, elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Maney was Okaloosa County Judge from 1989 to 2018 and is an attorney living in Shalimar.
Maney served in the U.S. Army on active and reserve duty from 1970 to 2007, retiring as a brigadier general, with overseas service in Panama, Haiti, Bosnia and Afghanistan.
Maney holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Kentucky and a law degree from the University of Louisville.
